heading: நூற்பெயர்
description: இதனை இயற்றியவர் கண்ணஞ்சேந்தனார். திணைக்குப் பத்துப்பாடல்கள் என ஐம்பது பாடல்களை இந்நூல் கொண்டுள்ளது. குறிஞ்சி, பாலை, முல்லை, மருதம், நெய்தல் என்ற முறை வைப்பில் அமைந்துள்ளது.
englishDescription: This is composed by kaṇṇaṉ cēntaṉār. This text consists of 50 verses, all in Venpa meter. This deals with the five-fold divisions of reciprocal love between well matched man and woman. The five-fold divisions are nothing but five distinctive situations namely kuṟiñci, mullai, marutam, neytal and pālai. Each division indicates the emotions and situations involved as well as the geographical landscape. The emotions and events involved are called uripporuḷ. And for distinct emotions and events, matching geographical region (land), native elements peculiar to that particular region, season and time are assigned as per Tamil literary tradition. The land and time together are called mutalporuḷ; the native elements peculiar to the region concerned are called karupporuḷ. This is to say that in each love poem an emotional situation is poetically painted against a setting best suited to the situation.
